_comment: SERVER INGESTION CONTRACT — identity & cross-dataset join keys.
This manifest is the authoritative, machine-checkable statement of the fields
the Azure->AWS server ingestion pipeline binds on, sourced from the server-side C#
classes) and the Consumption CSV header emitted by ResourceInventory.ps1.
SCOPE — this is deliberately NARROW. It pins only the IDENTITY and JOIN-KEY fields
that make the three datasets (Inventory / Metrics / Consumption) correlatable. It does
NOT pin the long tail of descriptive fields (SKU/tier/state/etc.), many of which are
not server-bound yet (see SERVER-SIDE-SCHEMA-GAPS.md) and are free to evolve. The gate
protects the contract that MATTERS: if these keys drift (renamed/removed/emptied) the
server silently drops the value (System.Text.Json ignores unmapped members) and the
datasets stop joining — at which point the data is, per the owner, useless on its own.
